entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An archangel created by Sorin Markov to protect Innistrad and central figure of the Church of Avacyn; she was corrupted and killed by Sorin.

entities.name: Echoverse Avacyn
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Avacyn, created by the rebel werewolf Sorin Markov, with black hair and wings and white clothes.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The shadowed plane Avacyn protected.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that rose from the power Sorin invested in Avacyn.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker who created Avacyn and finally unmade her.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon who challenged Avacyn, was driven into the Helvault and impaled her with his spear.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison in which demons and later Avacyn were bound.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: Lunarch who hosted Avacyn and witnessed her battle with Griselbrand.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who opened the Helvault hoping to destroy Griselbrand.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Guardian of the Helvault.

entities.name: Kelse
entities.description: Village outcast who prayed to Avacyn to find her son and was later burned by a beam of light.

entities.name: Maeli
entities.description: Kelse's son whom Avacyn rescued.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel who remained unconvinced by Avacyn's genocidal thoughts.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: Angel who gave in to the madness.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: Angel who gave in to the madness.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Sister of Bruna, Gisela and Sigarda, slain by Avacyn for allying with a demon lord.

entities.name: Liont
entities.description: Werewolf killed by Avacyn after he killed his own family.

entities.name: Lunarch Macher
entities.description: Lunarch who prayed for evidence of Avacyn's power and was verbally abused by her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried in vain to restrain Avacyn at Thraben Cathedral.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried in vain to restrain Avacyn at Thraben Cathedral.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose cryptoliths summoned Emrakul.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan summoned by Nahiri's cryptoliths, whose redirection of mana harmed the angels.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: The wave of spells in which Avacyn transformed many werewolves and foul curses.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: A new race of great wolf creatures into which Avacyn transformed the Gatstaf werewolves.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral in which Avacyn was confronted and unmade.

entities.name: Vault of the Archangel
entities.description: The place beneath the cathedral where Sorin created Avacyn.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: Remote village whose people appealed to Avacyn about the lycanthropic curse.

events.summary: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and tasks her with protecting Innistrad.
events.quote: The vampire planeswalker Sorin Markov created Avacyn and tasked her with protecting Innistrad.

events.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn at the Helvault; she drives him in but he impales her and she is imprisoned too.
events.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

events.summary: Liliana Vess forces Thalia to open the Helvault, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
events.quote: This resulted in the release of both the demons and Avacyn

events.summary: Avacyn offers the Gatstaf werewolves a place at her side and transforms them into wolfir in the Cursemute.
events.quote: she transformed them into the wolfir

events.summary: Rescuing Maeli, Avacyn is hit by a strange spell that fills her with disgust toward humans.
events.quote: This event, combined with foreign thoughts, caused Avacyn to feel a new sense of disgust toward humans.

events.summary: Avacyn's madness is revealed to be caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul.
events.quote: Avacyn's madness was caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul to the plane

events.summary: Avacyn verbally abuses Lunarch Macher and kills the werewolf Liont after his prayer.
events.quote: Avacyn responded to the prayer by breaking through the roof of Liont's house and killing him

events.summary: Avacyn visits Sigarda with Bruna and Gisela, advocating a genocidal solution and threatening Sigarda.
events.quote: Avacyn blew up Sigarda's roof and implied a threat towards her should she not collaborate

events.summary: Avacyn leads angels to slaughter Kelse's village and burns Kelse.
events.quote: slaughtering its inhabitants with beams of light and prompting a crisis of faith in Kelse

events.summary: At Thraben Cathedral Avacyn overpowers Jace and Tamiyo, then Sorin arrives and tells her he is her creator.
events.quote: Sorin told her that he was her creator, and Avacyn's madness momentarily withdrew

events.summary: Sorin plummets Avacyn into the Vault of the Archangel and unravels the spell that formed her; her last words are that she is to protect.
events.quote: I am Avacyn. I am to protect.

events.summary: Her faithful build a memorial to Avacyn from wood, straw, twine and clay.
events.quote: her faithful constructed a memorial for her

events.summary: A thousand years earlier Avacyn slew Liesa and her angel flight for allying with a demon lord.
events.quote: Avacyn single-handedly slew Liesa and her entire angel flight for their heresy
